title: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that uses benchmark datasets (like BOLD and FairPrim) to measure gender polarity, sentiment, and toxicity, as well as counterfactual evaluation by swapping genders in datasets to assess allocation bias.
Surveying literature that uses benchmark datasets (such as BOLD and FairPrim) to measure sentiment, toxicity, regard, and psycholinguistic norms across different racial groups.
Reviewing studies that quantify bias toward religious beliefs using benchmark datasets (e.g., BOLD and FairPrim) to assess metrics like sentiment and toxicity.
Surveying literature that evaluates political ideology biases in text generation using datasets like BOLD and FairPrim.
Reviewing approaches that measure profession-related biases by analyzing sentiment, toxicity, and regard using benchmark datasets like BOLD and FairPrim.
